source.author: ov
source.text: placat equo Persis radiis Hyperiona cinctum, ne detur celeri victima tarda deo.
source.text_original: placat equo Persis radiis Hyperiona cinctum, / ne detur celeri victima tarda deo.
source.text_english: Persia appeases Hyperion, girt with rays, by a horse, so that no slow victim be offered to the swift god.

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: nam sicut Lunae taurus mactatur, quia similia habet cornua, et placat equo Persis radiis Hyperiona cinctum, ne detur celeri uictima tarda deo, ita in hoc quia magnitudo membri uirilis enormis est, non potuit ei monstro aptior uictima reperiri quam quae posset ipsum cui mactatur imitari.
reuse.text_original: nam sicut Lunae taurus mactatur, quia similia habet cornua, et placat equo Persis radiis Hyperiona cinctum, ne detur celeri uictima tarda deo, ita in hoc quia magnitudo membri uirilis enormis est, non potuit ei monstro aptior uictima reperiri quam quae posset ipsum cui mactatur imitari.
reuse.text_english: For just as a bull is sacrificed to Luna because it has horns like hers, and the Persians propitiate Hyperion, encircled with rays, with a horse, lest a slow victim be given to a swift god, so in this case, because the size of the male member is enormous, no more suitable victim could be found for that monster than one that could imitate the very thing to which it is sacrificed.
